item.text: The current code has separate, duplicated process collection in Debian and Red Hat. Red Hat already queries RPM ownership by paths, but then resolves each result through `FindByFQPN`, which can fail when the package map retains only one installed variant. I’m consolidating process collection and making ownership results resolve to the exact installed package identity.

I updated RPM ownership parsing so the three specified error lines are ignored, malformed lines return errors, and package resolution compares the full package identity. The required `pkgPs` implementation and Debian/Red Hat `postScan` refactor are still incomplete, so the issue is not fully resolved.

`go test ./scan` was still running when I stopped.
